description.p: Cursor Clip keeps a searchable clipboard history and opens it next to the current pointer position. Select an entry to restore it to the clipboard, pin important entries, remove individual entries, or clear the history.

It is designed for Wayland compositors that implement the layer-shell and data-control protocols, including KDE Plasma, Hyprland, Sway, niri, labwc, and other wlroots-based compositors. GNOME Shell is not supported because it does not provide the required protocols.

Launching Cursor Clip starts its clipboard monitor for the current session. For clipboard monitoring immediately after login, configure flatpak run io.github.sirulex.cursor-clip --daemon in your compositor's autostart settings. Bind flatpak run io.github.sirulex.cursor-clip to a shortcut such as Super+V to open the history overlay.

description.p: The first stable release adds encrypted persistent history, image previews, pinning, search, theme support, and instant paste.
